questions.q: Which of these is an account-level attribute rather than a site-level one?
options: Profile class, which drives credit limit and dunning behavior
Tax registration for a specific warehouse
Bill-To language for one address
Ship-To designation for a single site
questions.explain: Profile class is assigned at the account level and drives relationship-wide behavior like credit limit and dunning, rather than varying by individual site.

questions.q: What happens when a customer has multiple Bill-To sites and no site is specified on a transaction?
options: The transaction fails and cannot be completed
Receivables defaults to the site flagged as the primary Bill-To
The invoice is sent to every Bill-To site
The transaction uses a random Bill-To site
questions.explain: A primary Bill-To site is flagged specifically to serve as the default when a transaction doesn't explicitly choose another site.

questions.q: Can a single physical address carry both a Bill-To and a Ship-To use?
options: No, each use requires a separate address
Only if the customer has no contacts
Yes — a small customer might have one office that is both billed and shipped to
Only for on-account credit memos
questions.explain: One account site can carry multiple site uses simultaneously; larger customers often split them across different addresses, but it isn't required.

questions.q: What is a 'contact' in the context of a Receivables customer record?
options: An application login used to access the customer portal
A GL account segment
A type of receivables activity
A named person to call or email about the account — not a system user
questions.explain: Contacts are reference people (billing, collections, service) attached at the party or account level; they are not application users.

questions.q: In the Cascade Outdoor Supply example, what role did the new Boise site play?
options: It was added as Ship-To only, while Spokane remained the primary Bill-To
It became the new primary Bill-To site
It replaced the Spokane site entirely
It was added as a contact, not a site
questions.explain: The Boise warehouse was added as a Ship-To site to support deliveries, while billing continued through the existing primary Bill-To site in Spokane.
